{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id values
duplicate_patients = data[data.duplicated(subset='patient_id', keep=False)]

# Count how many patients have duplicates
num_duplicate_patients = duplicate_patients['patient_id'].nunique()

# Check how many rows per patient
rows_per_patient = duplicate_patients.groupby('patient_id').size()

# Print summary
print(f"Total patients with duplicate entries: {num_duplicate_patients}")
print(f"Rows per duplicate patient:\n{rows_per_patient}")

# Check if sample_seq is higher in the duplicate rows
# For each patient, check if the highest sample_seq row is the one we should keep
max_seq_per_patient = duplicate_patients.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()

# Check if the max sample_seq is unique per patient (i.e., no ties)
max_seq_ties = max_seq_per_patient.duplicated().any()

# Print tie info
print(f"Ties in sample_seq for highest sequence? {max_seq_ties}")"}
